CustomField.description: PacPoint JF 2/24/25: Created for flag to indicate disciplinary action against the license
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( TEXT(Status__c) = "Z - Current & Valid, But Subject To Disciplinary Requirement", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZC - Voluntarily Surrender Or Forfeit License Due To Disciplinary Action", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZF - Terminated Due To Recovery Fund Payout", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZP - Voluntary Suspension", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZR - Revoked", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZS - Suspended", TEXT(Status__c) = "ZV - Voluntary Revocation"), true, false)
CustomField.label: Disciplinary Action
